# Grandma Irving & Mary Joe

- [Grandma Irving](../character/grandma-irving.md) — Commands — [Mary Joe](../character/mary-joe.md) — since v2  <sub>[v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P10](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0010)</sub>

## Shared scenes

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) spends a pleasant late-August day rowing with [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) and the twins before visiting [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md) at his grandmother's house. Over tea and in his room, [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) shares his imaginative thoughts and worries, which [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) reassures him about. Returning home to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) puts a jealous [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) to bed and later meets [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) by the Dryad's [Bubble](../codex/places.md#dryad-s-bubble).
>
> — v2 · XIX Just a Happy Day

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) finishes her teaching term, leaving local mothers to gossip about her future and [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md). She later visits [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) and then Paul's home, where she meets Paul's father, [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md), who asks her to pass a message to Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md). [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) joyfully acts as a matchmaker, delivering Stephen's request and helping Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) prepare for his arrival.
>
> — v2 · XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace
